source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of file handling (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File handling ka matlab hai files se parhna aur un mein likhna. Data ko pakke taur par (persistently) mehfooz rakhne ke liye yeh zaroori hai, kyunke program band hone par variables ki values khatam ho jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Programs ko file handling kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Program khatam hone par variables khatam ho jate hain; files data rakhti hain ta ke baad mein dobara istemal ho.

items: File handling: files mein data parhna aur likhna.
